title: Without the Reports permission the Dashboard is not available
custom_preconds: 1. On the build under test, have a user to sign in as who does NOT have the Reports permission (set under Settings - Staff / Roles); a single workplace is selected.
custom_steps:
1. As the user without the Reports permission, confirm there is no 'Dashboard' entry and no way to open the dashboard.
2. Log in as that user and confirm they do not land on the dashboard.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Without the Reports permission, the "Dashboard" entry is not shown and the user cannot open the dashboard.
  • Without the Reports permission, the user does not land on the dashboard at login.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9573 (S1 — Access & Entry Point); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S1; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “If the user does not have the Reports permission, the "Dashboard" entry is not shown and the user cannot open the dashboard.”
  • S1-N2: “If the user does not have the Reports permission, they do not land on the dashboard when they log in.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
